content.text:
**Finding: T4C — compliant (sits at/above the fallback).**

- **Customer exit:** § 14 (p0079) is an unconditional Client election to terminate with no cause requirement, effective the last day of the month following the notice month (~30–60 days' run-off). That is a convenience right notwithstanding the absent label, and it is no worse than the fallback's 60–90 day window.
- **No penalty:** no early-termination fee or exit charge appears anywhere, so the three-months-of-fees cap is satisfied.
- **Vendor exit:** TrueLink has no mid-term convenience right. § 13 (p0078) allows mid-term cut-off of §§ 2–3 only on Client breach/default (for cause); the mutual 30-day notice is non-renewal expressly tied to the end of the then-current one-year term, which belongs under RENEWAL and is not double-flagged here. No suspension/withdrawal-for-convenience right exists in §§ 2, 5, 8 or 9.
- **Term length:** one-year initial term, so the multi-year walk-away trigger does not apply.
- **Noted, not flagged:** no express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees (preferred-only sub-element), which is immaterial since § 5(a) bills monthly in arrears with payment 15 days after invoice.

No redline proposed.
